content: Ctrl/Cmd+click encounters to select several fights and combine their metrics.
Use the Bosses filter to hide trash encounters and focus on boss pulls.
Switch encounter ordering to move between grouped fights and the chronological raid timeline.
Select players or enemies to filter panels to damage, healing, and events involving those units.
Use the Roles panel to select all tanks, healers, or damage dealers at once.
Right-click a supported player row to focus it and open a per-ability breakdown.
Layouts can be shared so everyone in a raid can start from the same panel setup.
Chronicle stores encounter, entity, and panel selections in the URL so you can share the exact view.
